Service Project: Removing Invasive Species in Big Rock Park

Get your hands dirty and make a difference! Join us for a community conservation effort to remove invasive honeysuckle, restore native habitats, and protect our local ecosystems. Come give back to the community, enjoy the outdoors, and help make a lasting impact on the environment! Snacks and hot beverages will be provided. 
There will be a limited number of tools and gloves available for use. Feel free to bring your outdoor gloves, pruner, lopper, and/or handsaw. 

Saturday, November 14

There's still time to apply to be an RA!

Are you interested in gaining leadership skills, helping others, meeting new people, and having your own room? Then click here to join the res life team! Please note that you need to logged into Handshake in order to view the job listing . Benefits include a partial room waiver, a double-as-a-single room at no extra charge, and a flexible work schedule. See your RA or area coordinator if you have questions!

TRIVIA NIGHT!! Sunday, November 15th, 7:00pm

The History Club invites you to Trivia Night on Sunday, November 15th, 7:00pm in the BMW rooms. Take a break from studying, but still exercise your brain! Snacks and Cash Prizes!! Teams of 2-4. If you don't have a team, come anyway -- we'll put you on one!! Everyone participates!
